name: Glycolysis / Gluconeogenesis
description: Reprogramming of glucose metabolism from hepatic gluconeogenesis to aerobic glycolysis (Warburg effect) during early hepatocarcinogenesis.

name: Fatty Acid Degradation / Beta-Oxidation
description: Mitochondrial and peroxisomal fatty acid oxidation, critically impaired during simple steatosis and MASH transition to HCC.

name: Fatty Acid Biosynthesis & Lipogenesis
description: De novo lipogenesis driving steatosis and cellular membrane synthesis in rapidly proliferating early liver tumors.

name: Primary Bile Acid Biosynthesis
description: Hepatic conversion of cholesterol into bile acids; dysregulation causes cholestatic hepatotoxicity and promotes oncogenic inflammation.

name: Retinol (Vitamin A) Metabolism
description: Depletion of hepatic stellate cell retinoids is an early hallmark trigger of liver fibrosis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma.

name: Citrate Cycle (TCA Cycle)
description: Central energetic hub oxidatively metabolizing acetyl-CoA; altered TCA flux provides biosynthetic precursors for early liver tumor growth.

name: PPAR Signaling Pathway
description: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptors regulating hepatic lipid homeostasis, inflammation, and malignant progression.

name: Metabolism of Xenobiotics by Cytochrome P450
description: Hepatic phase I detoxification system; widespread downregulation of CYPs marks early loss of differentiated hepatocyte identity.

name: Cysteine and Methionine Metabolism (One-Carbon)
description: MAT1A to MAT2A transcriptional switch and GNMT suppression alters S-adenosylmethionine (SAMe) levels, predisposing hepatocytes to HCC.

name: Arginine Biosynthesis and Urea Cycle
description: Hepatic clearance of ammonia; disruption of urea cycle enzymes leads to nitrogen diversion for nucleotide biosynthesis in cancer.

name: Pentose Phosphate Pathway
description: Generates NADPH for reductive biosynthesis and ribose-5-phosphate for nucleotide synthesis essential for malignant transformation.

name: PI3K-Akt Signaling Pathway
description: Key oncogenic pathway hyperactivated in early hepatocellular carcinoma driving metabolic reprogramming and cell survival.
